builder: self-contained current-user Windows setup executable with embedded bounded payload
note: The private installer registers only a current-user Windows Installed-apps entry. The registered uninstaller is confirmation-gated for interactive use and permanently removes only the declared ZTerminal-owned local application, roaming data, shortcuts, registration, cache/history, workspace, and diagnostic paths. The test used isolated path and registry overrides and opened no network connection. The installer remains unsigned pending a real authorized code-signing certificate.
